questions.question: How did Sanballat and Tobiah respond to the building?
options: Mocked, then plotted to attack Jerusalem
Ignored it and left them alone
Sent gifts to support the builders
Helped, sending many workers to speed it along
questions.answer: Mocked, then plotted to attack Jerusalem

questions.question: How did the builders protect themselves while working?
options: They built only under cover of darkness at night
They stopped the work until the threat passed
They hired foreign soldiers to defend the wall
Half worked while half stood guard with weapons
questions.answer: Half worked while half stood guard with weapons

questions.question: The workers carried a load with one hand and held a weapon with the other.
Tobiah mocked that if a fox went up on the wall it would break down their stone _____.
Nehemiah told them not to be afraid but to remember the Lord, who is great and _____.
